title: Make AI output usable with a schema
subtitle: Turn free-form responses into validated data
learning_objective: Explain how schema-constrained output and application validation work together.

source_refs.title: OpenAI: Structured Outputs
source_refs.supports: constraining model output to a JSON schema

scenes.title: THE PARSER BROKE
scenes.body: Your app expects JSON, but the model adds an introduction, omits a field, and changes an enum.

scenes.title: Constrain the shape
scenes.body: Structured-output features can constrain responses to a schema. The application still needs to handle refusals, incomplete responses, business rules, and downstream failures.

scenes.title: Validate the contract
Schema isn't fact-checking
scenes.body: Valid JSON can contain false information. Structural validation and factual review solve different problems.

scenes.question: What does schema-constrained output not guarantee by itself?
scenes.explanation: A schema can constrain structure and types, but it cannot prove that the content is factually true.

scenes.title: Remember this
scenes.body: Constrain structure, validate business rules, and independently check factual quality.
